Tamil Nadu challenges court ruling on Muslim convert reservation in Supreme Court

The Tamil Nadu government has approached the Supreme Court challenging a Madras High Court ruling that denied Backward Class reservation benefits to individuals converting to Islam. The state's move follows the High Court's decision to quash these benefits, a stance that has also drawn condemnation from rights groups. The case centers on the eligibility of converts for reservation quotas.
